subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should maintainers require redacted real Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof for this PR, or explicitly override the proof gate based on deterministic manager-level coverage?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but the repository proof policy treats external PR unit/mock evidence as supplemental for runtime recovery changes, and the contributor says no live Gateway/Ollama harness proof is available.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and successful after-recovery search before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression as enough for this narrow bug, owning the remaining live-provider uncertainty.

options.title: Pause for owner review
options.body: Hold the PR until a memory-core owner can decide whether to sponsor live proof or land under an override.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and successful after-recovery search before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent memory-core history tie this person most directly to the central manager/provider fallback code under review.
